posts.text: Barnes has been the underdog in all three Elite 8 games so far. Will take an extraordinary performance to win a default road game in Chicago against Michigan. But this team has peaked at the right time. Ament knee injury slowed them down late in SEC, but team is playing best now.

Tennessee had one elite 8 in program history when Rick Barnes joined the Vols. Barnes has now taken Tennessee to three straight Elite 8’s. Pretty phenomenal run, all time elite coach. Hope he never retires.

Ridiculous play for a big man here. Vols have dominated the glass, but turned it over way too much. Insanely physical game.

Video
This Duke-St. John’s game is phenomenal. Both teams just standing in the center of the ring throwing haymakers.
Appears to be way more cameras, way more drone shots, just higher quality overall. I’m sure there will be kinks as with any new offering, but it’s already impressive. Great addition.

Well done.
